map.镜中像左右反吗？: Is the image in a mirror left-right reversed?
map.是前后反（深度镜像）而非左右反，习惯说「左右反」是相对自身的前后翻转。: It is front-back reversed (depth mirroring), not left-right; the habitual phrase "left-right reversed" is really front-back reversal relative to yourself.
map.夹角成像公式？: What is the angle imaging formula?
map.整数夹角 θ 时像数=360/θ−1（θ 整除 360），否则取 floor。: For an integer angle θ, number of images = 360/θ−1 (when θ divides 360 exactly), otherwise take the floor.
map.球面镜成像（本页代码口径）：焦距 f = R ÷ 2；像距 v = 1 ÷ (1: Spherical mirror imaging (as coded on this page): focal length f = R ÷ 2; image distance v = 1 ÷ (1 ÷ f − 1 ÷ u) (mm, i.e. 1/v = 1/f − 1/u); magnification m = −v ÷ u (the negative-sign convention is kept). Validation: u and R are guarded as non-empty; all-zero input reports an error; when R is 0, f=0 makes v undefined and the renderer falls back to "—". Criteria: v >0 means a real image, otherwise a virtual image, annotated together with the magnification.
